headline: Bench options and costs, cemetery signage rules, and Eldredge water service inquiries top the agenda.
summary: A presentation on cemetery naming and rules signs will be given by Andy Brumbaugh. Items also cover Eldredge fence repairs, a Tree City USA planting project, and shopping cart and trash at the Shelburne Rd cemetery.
items: Presentation on cemetery naming and rules signage options by Andy Brumbaugh
Consider bench options, including types, materials, and costs
Review of inquiries into an Eldredge water service
Review of inquiries into Eldredge fence repairs and improvement
Review of Nick Garty's Tree City USA planting project held at Eldredge on 24 October
Update on shopping cart and trash at Shelburne Rd cemetery by Peter Taylor
Disclosure of Chair's reimbursed expenses for 2025 and 2026
